rv.q: Evil Perfect is a messy and seductive play that attempts to reveal how good people with honorable intentions become evil.
Huffman’s play raises provocative questions about individual rights, free will, equality, and the common good, and it illustrates how societies can veer from one dangerous extreme to another.
Evil Perfect is a thought-provoking, adrenaline-filled experience that lingers long after the final curtain call.

cn.t: Critics praise "Evil Perfect" as a compelling dystopian thriller that skillfully blends Orwellian surveillance with thought-provoking questions about equity and individuality, delivering an immersive 90-minute experience.
